public final class MultiEnumSetting<E extends Enum<E>> extends Setting<Set<E>>
Several choices from an enum at once, rendered as a checkbox list.

Replaces the pile of adjacent booleans a module grows for target filters (Players, Mobs, Animals, Invisibles) and the old MultipleBoolean type. One setting means one config entry, one GUI row, and a single has(E) call at the use site instead of a chain of boolean ands.
